title: Strangeness Identification
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the strangeness of the Sigma* based on the conservation laws in the given reactions.

title: Decay Type Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain why the decay of Sigma* is classified as strong or weak based on the decay width and lifetime calculations.

title: Isospin Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the isospin of Sigma* and justify it using the information provided about the decay process.

title: Decay Width Calculation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may calculate the decay width for the decay channel Sigma* -> Lambda pi+ to support their explanation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect sign assignments for strangeness or misclassifying the decay type.
